name: Tone & Style Enforcer
description: Ensure text matches a consistent tone and style, adjusting language, structure, and formatting.

phrases: enforce this tone across my content
make this match my brand voice
standardize the style of this text

inputs.label: Content
inputs.help: Text to check and adjust for tone consistency.

inputs.label: Tone
inputs.help: Desired tone (e.g. professional, casual, formal). Defaults to professional.

outputs.description: Structured tone analysis and adjusted text.

grants.reason: Allow the skill to read lightweight local context when invoked from a workspace.
